Controlled cache study

We measured a wide row and a use-case-specific projection against fixed light and heavy fixtures. Warm runs followed a fixed warmup; cold runs restarted the database between samples.

LightWide6401.8

The numbers are invented for extraction testing and are not evidence about WebTag. A real report must include the seed, PostgreSQL version, buffer counters, allocations, concurrency, and exact reproduction command.
